limitations: Windows 371-group evidence is retained unchanged from 2026-09-08-Foundation-Fresh-Source-Text-Execution.json (19548 ms). That record's deliberately interrupted Debian attempt remains historical incomplete evidence; this later completed selection closes its host gap.

Analyzer packaging stages reported 35 seconds complete verification, 243 seconds staging, and 237 seconds container build. Emitter packaging reported 31, 132, and 139 seconds respectively. These stages ran independently with 900-second outer limits. The final 36717-ms selection uses warm construction caches and is not a cold-build benchmark. Peak working-set memory was not measured.

An initial shell-quoted Linux launch failed before successful direct invocation.

The six rejection inputs are Borrow-Missing-Explicit.wv, Borrow-Immutable-To-Mutable.wv, Borrow-Mutable-From-Let.wv, Borrow-Escape-Local.wv, Borrow-Return.wv, and Borrow-Owned-Read-Through.wv under Tests/Fixtures/Language-1.0. Each uses the same analyzer invocation with a unique output prefix and requires exit 1, wir-status=Invalidˉborrow, and absent wvss/wvca/wvlb/wvir outputs. The last case originally failed at Sourceˉsymbols because builder<i32, 8u32> was invalid type syntax. Correcting both capacities to 8 reaches the intended consuming-call rejection at line 8, column 20.

The seven call-site cases use WVB 1.11 and the retained WebAssembly scalar subset, with 228 guest and 456324 outer instructions. They prove Copy/shared aggregate read-through and named borrow rejections, not WVB 1.39 browser admission, the complete front-door suite, or arbitrary owned-payload execution.

The 371-group selection does not run the full 552-case memory/task/borrow owner. The 329-group front-end development bundle does not exercise Source-Wir-Core call sites and was not used as substitute evidence. Broad task, callable, installed-tool, native ABI, OS, bootstrap, and full qualification gates were not run.

Runner packages still derive from the same previously built runner WVB. This is selected paired-host source compilation and execution, not independent full bootstrap reconstruction or release qualification. Maintained consumer integration, exclusive borrows, take, map, wider payload/native lowering, and installed toolchain promotion remain open.
